posts.topic_title: Cost-efficient 405nm pigtailed diode laser with SM/PM Fiber
posts.author: Tom B.
posts.post_subject: Cost-efficient 405nm pigtailed diode laser with SM/PM Fiber
posts.content_md:
I hate it when vendors tout "cost effective" as a main feature and then are coy about actual pricing. You have to call

them and haggle and waste a bunch of time... It would be much more efficient to publish a reasonable list price,

indicating that huge discounts are available for those willing to haggle.

And it looks like their bare diodes are specified at 2 nm FWHM linewidth, way too wide for holography. But then the red diodes we

all know and love were similarly disparaged... I still don't know why they work...
